text:
nina: quick one  flew to Berlin for client week, kept all receipts except two taxi rides (no paper, driver gave a small slip that fell out). what's the policy for lost receipts and foreign currency?
aj: sorry to hear that. short policy: we can accept a Lost Receipt Declaration + bank/card statement showing the charge. For foreign currency, reimburse in USD at the card conversion rate on the statement.
michael: add practical steps: 1) get a copy of the card transaction (screenshot from bank) showing date, merchant, and amount; 2) fill the Lost Receipt form (link in Travel policy) and explain why; 3) upload both to Expensify and mark as "Lost receipt". Finance will review.
nina: lost receipt form location?
aj: Confluence -> People Ops -> Travel & Expenses -> "Lost or Missing Receipts". Or use this path in Expensify when submitting: Expense Type -> Taxi -> check "Missing receipt" and attach bank statement + short note.
finance-bot: automated note: "For missing receipts > $75, manager approval is required in addition to Lost Receipt Declaration. Reimbursements in foreign currency will be converted at the bank rate on the transaction date. Finance may cap reimbursement if documentation insufficient."
nina: both taxi fares are under $40 each (EUR). do i need manager sign-off?
michael: under $75 each, manager sign-off not required unless out-of-policy flags. still attach the bank statement lines. include approximate merchant name like "Taxi Berlin" and add travel request id.
nina: currency rounding  my card shows two EUR charges, bank shows USD amounts that differ by a few cents. which do you reimburse?
aj: we reimburse the exact USD amount on your bank/card statement. if you paid cash in EUR and have no bank charge, use the per diem or treat as out-of-pocket actuals with receipt (but cash receipts needed).
nina: i paid by card, so i'm good. last Q: is a photo of the small paper slip acceptable or does it need to be legible scan?
michael: photo is fine if legible. take both sides, include date/amount/merchant. if it's smudged, attach the Lost Receipt Declaration and bank statement as backup.
nina: thanks! uploading now. tagging @aj in case finance flags it. :thumbsup:
